Backtest charges a 5 bp one-way commission and each sleeve's half-spread on the notional traded, the fill's slippage — a buy at (open + high) / 2 and a sell at (open + low) / 2 of the fill candle, relative to its open — the square-root market impact on the book's size, and a funding drag where a strategy sets one.
